integrity: The displayed coefficients are derived analytically from the source formulas; no numerical fit, finite enumeration, external certification, or independent review is represented as proof.
scientific_limitations: Local asymptotic statement for fixed p in (0,1/2); it is not uniform at the parameter endpoints.
The universal-side quantity is the explicit phase-uniform converse exponent D(t_R||p) from the rotated-qubit example; no broader low-rate or all-channel cubic law is claimed.
No claim is made that the cubic coefficient is a universal invariant of noncommutativity.
title: Near capacity, the rotated-qubit phase-uniform reliability gap is cubic
